name: literature
description: Literature pack: verifies citations and resolves DOIs and arXiv IDs through the CiteNexus MCP server (cite-nexus-mcp 0.2.3, key-free Crossref, DataCite, Europe PMC and arXiv), with an offline extractor for BibTeX and Markdown and a web_fetch fallback. Extends arxiv-literature. Needs network for every lookup; the server needs one online launch to install.
